Search for a destination

Discover ways to use your Points

Use them how you want, when you want. Find out how easy it is to pay for your next getaway.

1/3

Buy, gift, pool, transfer, and restore Hilton Honors Points

The possibilities are endless. Where will your Points take you?

Points expire after 24 months of inactivity, but we can help you get them back.

Restore Your Points

How to maximize the value of Points & Money rewards

Points & Money Rewards™: A more flexible way to travel

Don't have enough Points for that week-long getaway? Want to book that upgraded room you’ve been dreaming about? You can use ANY combination of Points and money to pay for your stay in increments of 1,000 Points, starting at 5,000 Points.

Book Now

Find your next getaway with Points

Redeem your hard-earned Points on your dream stay. No blackout dates, no resort fees, and no hidden terms.

Redeem Now

What can you book with Points & Money Rewards™?

The possibilities are endless when you use Points & Money. Here are a few real life examples to get you started.

Conrad Bahrain for 20,000 Points + $146.74 per night

Our prime location on the Manama Seafront places us just moments away from the high-end shopping havens of The Avenues and City Centre Bahrain.

View Conrad Bahrain

Canopy by Hilton Osaka Umeda for 40,000 Points + $263.30 per night

Experience the city like a local and visit near key attractions such as the Kuchu Teien Observatory, the Umeda Sky Building, and the Grand Front Osaka Mall.

View Canopy by Hilton Osaka Umeda

Waldorf Astoria Seychelles Platte Island for 100,000 Points + $430.15 per night

Our private island in Seychelles offers pristine beaches, a range of exclusive activities, six restaurants and bars, and the iconic Waldorf Astoria Spa.

View Waldorf Astoria Seychelles Platte Island
